integrity: The proof derives every necessary pair inequality from a two-spoke resolving neighborhood, proves those inequalities sufficient because every resolving neighborhood contains at least two outer vertices, and then classifies the coordinatewise-minimal points of the resulting monotone polytope. A separate checker reconstructs graph distances and solves the unreduced vertex-level LP.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to friendship graphs with at least two triangles.
The scalar value edim_f(F_k)=k is prior work; the new content is the feasible-system reduction, full minimal-function classification, weight interval, and optimizer uniqueness.
Finite LP verification through k=8 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased optimizer classification.
title: All minimal fractional edge resolvers of friendship graphs
